title: GitLab issue collection
description: The list endpoint must always return a JSON array, including for a single result and for an empty result. Each element must satisfy the single-issue contract.

title.description: Not constrained by maxLength on purpose. The 255-character limit is request validation, asserted by IssueBoundaryTest.acceptsTitleAtMaximumLength and rejectsTitleBeyondMaximumLength against Issue.TITLE_MAX_LENGTH. Asserting it here would instead claim the API never RETURNS a longer title, so raising the limit would fail every read of a legitimately created issue rather than the one boundary test meant to detect the change. minLength is different: an issue always having a non-empty title is a genuine response invariant.
